note: Hardin County Conservation park on the west bank of the Iowa River, NW of Steamboat Rock, with an 8-acre fishing lake about 350 m north through the woods. Season about April to September. The pads on imagery run about 14-20 m; the south and east pads sit 20-30 m from the river behind a band of bank trees, and a reviewer warns the campground can flood quickly when the river rises. A shooting range in the park can be heard by day. --Claude
summary: mycountyparks confirms the electric camping area ('over 40 campers'), primitive sites, modern toilets, showers and water. Hardin County's own site still 403s; its fee text (30/50-amp $18/$23, read by AWH) gives 50A. Riverview stands as a weak call; the lake is not in view. Phone 641-648-4361 found.
